evidence.detail: geo-join r=1500 m -> 2 facilities (2 oil & gas)
evidence.sql:
SELECT p.source_name, f.facility_id, f.facility_name, f.latitude, f.longitude, f.parent_company,
       f.naics_code, f.reported_subparts, f.reported_industry_types, e.ch4_co2e_t,
       2 * 6371000 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(f.latitude - p.lat) / 2), 2)
         + COS(RADIANS(p.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(f.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(f.longitude - p.lon) / 2), 2))) AS dist_m
FROM skyledger.cm_sources p
JOIN skyledger.ghgrp_facilities f
  ON f.latitude BETWEEN p.lat - 0.0135 AND p.lat + 0.0135
 AND f.longitude BETWEEN p.lon - 0.0160 AND p.lon + 0.0160
LEFT JOIN (SELECT facility_id, SUM(ch4_co2e_t) AS ch4_co2e_t FROM skyledger.ghgrp_ch4 GROUP BY facility_id) e
  ON e.facility_id = f.facility_id
WHERE p.source_name = 'CH4_1B2_500m_-101.77420_31.84466'
ORDER BY dist_m

agents.name: SourceMapper
agents.role: Checks which sources are reachable (Zetaris or the cached sample) and their coverage

agents.name: GeoLinker
agents.role: Federated geo-join: plume to GHGRP facilities within a radius, with reported CH4

agents.name: PlumeReader
agents.role: Reads the plume image and wind; can overturn GeoLinker's nearest-facility pick

agents.name: OwnershipResolver
agents.role: Resolves messy owner strings to parent companies on the Meterless World Model

agents.name: Reconciler
agents.role: Converts kg/h and CO2e into comparable annual tonnes; always a range

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.role: Must rule out 5 rival explanations; can block the Reporter or send work back

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Writes the draft dossier in guarded language

agents.name: SignOff
agents.role: Nothing is shareable until an analyst signs an execution contract
